phase: Phase 25: Alpine Extreme Reach & Satellite Gateway Integration

stories.title: Pure KMP Satellite Communicator Emergency Gateway Bridge
stories.description: Implement SatelliteModels.kt and SatelliteGatewayBridge.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/satellite/. Provides fail-safe lifeline bridging when both local BLE mesh and cellular relays are unreachable. Converts CRASH_ALERT and emergency SOS beacons into condensed Iridium Short Burst Data (SBD) / Garmin inReach text frames (GPS coordinates, elevation, rider ID, impact g-force) and routes satellite dispatch ACK notifications back into local mesh HUD. Pure Kotlin with zero Java/C dependencies (Rules 2 & 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP implementation with zero Java, C, or platform-specific dependencies in commonMain (Rules 2 & 3)
Defines SatelliteLinkState, SatelliteModemType, SatelliteDispatchPayload, and SatelliteDispatchAck data models with full serialization
Encodes emergency mesh packets into compact <= 120-byte Iridium SBD binary/text frames with Base64 & CRC-16 checksum
Handles satellite transmit queues, offline buffering, timeout retries, and bi-directional ACK propagation into local mesh HUD
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Long-Range BLE Coded PHY (S=8) & Alpine Terrain Attenuation Model
stories.description: Implement AlpineRfModels.kt and AdaptivePhyArbiter.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/phy/. Dynamically negotiates BLE PHY layer modes (LE 1M, LE 2M, LE Coded S=2, LE Coded S=8 125 kbps) to achieve > 500m line-of-sight reach across alpine canyons and mountain switchbacks, compensating for deep terrain shadowing and thermal ducting.
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP PHY capability and alpine terrain modeling (BlePhyMode: LE_1M, LE_2M, CODED_S2, CODED_S8)
Adaptive PHY selection algorithm evaluating RSSI gradient, terrain altitude delta, and packet loss ratio
Automated fallback and hysteresis dampening preventing ping-pong PHY oscillations during convoy switchbacks
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Wearable Quick-PTT Companion Protocol & Biometric Vitals Beacon
stories.description: Implement WearableCompanionModels.kt and WearableCompanionProtocol.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/wearable/. Enables standalone smartwatch companion integration (WearOS & watchOS) providing glove-friendly handlebar quick-PTT toggle, haptic tap event signaling, and biometric heart rate telemetry streaming across the mesh for rider distress detection.
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP wearable companion message definitions and bidirectional state synchronization
Zero-latency PTT press/release state machine with debouncing and haptic feedback triggers
Compressed biometric vitals packet encoding (heart rate, stress indicator, battery level)
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Alpine Expedition Multi-Target Simulation Harness & Architecture Showcase Update
stories.description: Implement AlpineExpeditionSimulationHarness.kt simulating a 24-node high-altitude mountain expedition. Validates LE Coded PHY long-distance links across deep switchbacks, automated satellite SOS dispatch fallback in canyon dead zones, and updates Archify architecture showcase with 9/9 verification pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates 24 nodes traversing high-altitude alpine terrain with elevation deltas and switchbacks
Validates seamless PHY transitions to CODED_S8 maintaining voice intelligibility beyond 500m
Validates failover to SatelliteGatewayBridge dispatching emergency SBD beacons when mesh splits and cell is dead
Archify architecture specification and HTML showcase updated with 9/9 verification pass
Full multiplatform test suite pass across all targets
